summary: Overall quality is mixed: the notebook runs end-to-end and the reported test accuracy matches the computed output, but there is a major methodological flaw. The most important finding is data leakage: the scaler is fit on the full dataset before the train/test split, which contaminates the test set and makes results unreliable. In the interview, verify that the candidate understands proper ML pipelines (fit preprocessing only on the training set, e.g., via scikit-learn Pipeline/ColumnTransformer) and can explain why accuracy is misleading on imbalanced churn data, including how they would evaluate and improve recall/precision and choose decision thresholds.
